name: Chenyu Vale
description:
When Adventure Experience reaches 2: Create 2 Chenyu Brew and add them to your Hand.
When Adventure Experience reaches 4: You gain 3 stacks of Efficient Switch and Agile Switch.
When Adventure Experience reaches 8: All your characters gain Hydro Application. Heal the character on your team who has taken the most DMG for 10 HP and that character gains an additional 2 Max HP. Then, discard this card.
